lead: A scroll container with fading edges: while the content can still scroll in a direction, the edge on that side fades out to hint that there is more; at the end the fade disappears. Scrolling is native and the scrollbar stays (it can be hidden). It complements [Scroll Area](/scroll-area), which draws its own scrollbar.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.root: The scroll container; `data-orientation` / `data-scrollbar`; `data-shadow-start` / `data-shadow-end` mean there is more content on that side (faded); `--ss-size` holds the fade length
styling.content: Wraps the content (stretched to the content's width when horizontal)
